extendedPreviewContent.subtitle: One simple idea connects every frontend architecture pattern.

paragraphs.name: 51e6
paragraphs.text: One simple idea connects every frontend architecture pattern.
Every frontend interview I’ve prepped for eventually asks the same question wearing a different costume. Not what did you build. But why did you build it that way.

paragraphs.name: 38b7
paragraphs.text: For a long time, I didn’t have a real answer beyond “it’s what the team already had.”

paragraphs.name: 9a42
paragraphs.text: Here’s the thing I wish someone had told me earlier.

paragraphs.name: c328
paragraphs.text: Frontend architecture patterns are all answers to one question: how much work should the browser do, versus the server, versus build time?Everything elselike SSR, RSC, micro-frontends, BFFs is just a different place to draw that line.

paragraphs.name: 22bc
paragraphs.text: Quick honesty note before we start.

paragraphs.name: 67b7
paragraphs.text:
I haven’t personally led a micro-frontend migration at a 200-engineer
company.

paragraphs.name: 9b41
paragraphs.text:
Everything in this article comes from building production applications,
official documentation, and engineering write-ups from companies like
SoundCloud, Netflix, Spotify, Vercel, and Cloudflare.

paragraphs.name: 06ca
paragraphs.text: Where I’m talking about a company’s experience, I’ll say so.

paragraphs.name: 0fda
paragraphs.text:
I think that’s far more useful than pretending I’ve done everything
myself.
